title: Working memory or storage?
instruction: Where is it on the phone right now? In working memory, which forgets when the app closes, or in storage?

items.text: A message you are writing that the app hasn’t saved yet
items.why: So far it exists only in the app’s memory.
A saved photo is permanently in storage.

items.text: A game in progress that you have open right now
items.why: The game keeps its state in working memory.
The app sits in storage even when it isn’t running.

items.text: A page open in the browser
items.why: The browser keeps it in memory, which is why it loads again after you close it.

items.text: A song downloaded to listen to offline
items.why: Once downloaded, it is permanently in storage.

debrief: Working memory holds only what is being worked on right now. What should survive closing the app has to be in storage.
